observedIssues.fact: The paused performance Work Item correctly preserved its original Start Receipt but had no governed way to advance Contract baseCommit after mandatory corrective PRs #412 and #413 closed.
observedIssues.decision: Pause performance and complete this dedicated corrective before resuming.
observedIssues.resolution: Implemented generated append-only resumeHistory, canonical fail-closed validation, PR reuse, negative regressions, and bilingual lifecycle guidance.
observedIssues.followUp: Complete this corrective PR/CI/merge/close lifecycle, then invoke the command on the performance Work Item and rerun its Preflight.

observedIssues.fact: The comprehensive plan requires each Work Item to record documentationAlignment in Summary, but the current Summary validator rejects documentationAlignment as an unknown field.
observedIssues.decision: Preserve the completed alignment evidence in allowed Summary fields, record the schema gap, and schedule a dedicated corrective before performance/release continuation.
observedIssues.resolution: Open; do not weaken the Summary validator or silently discard the alignment requirement.
observedIssues.followUp: Add a validated documentationAlignment schema and lifecycle gate with regression coverage in a separate corrective Work Item.

observedIssues.fact: Coverage Guard correctly rejected the new production script because its existing focused tests were not registered in coverage_policy.yaml.
observedIssues.decision: Register the resume writer under the startReceipt association and rerun the complete finish sequence.
observedIssues.resolution: Resolved by mapping scripts/ai_resume_work_item.py to tests/test_start_and_archive.py and tests/test_pr_aggregate.py through the existing startReceipt domain.
observedIssues.followUp: The restarted ai-finish must prove Coverage Guard and full quality both pass.

observedIssues.fact: During the live project-test Gate, an internal test overwrote target/quality/timing/project-test.json with a 17ms fixture result while the real pytest process had already run for about seven minutes.
observedIssues.decision: Do not use the transient timing as performance evidence; retain this concrete reproduction for the already-planned per-run timing-session isolation work.
observedIssues.resolution: Open in the deep-performance Work Item; each quality run must use a unique run/session directory and tests must not share the live evidence destination.
observedIssues.followUp: Implement run-ID/commit-bound timing directories, stream progress, and publish failure artifacts before hosted performance acceptance.

observedIssues.fact: The first complete project-test ran 1245 passing tests but measured 84.95% coverage, and Bandit found five new low-risk findings (B404/B603/B607) from controlled Git subprocess helpers.
observedIssues.decision: Add focused negative-path tests to recover the 85% floor and explicitly update the low-risk Bandit digest after reviewing list-form, no-shell subprocess boundaries; do not lower thresholds or suppress the scan.
observedIssues.resolution: Tests now cover malformed JSON, predecessor evidence failures, and out-of-repository Contracts; full quality proved 1247 passed, 85.01% coverage, exact 114-finding baseline, and zero medium/high findings.
observedIssues.followUp: Preserve the same thresholds and evidence in the final fresh finish run after checkpoint refresh.

observedIssues.fact: After full quality, Agent Risk rejected the stale before_edit checkpoint because coverage policy and Bandit baseline had been added to the Contract after the original before_edit record; only before_finish had been refreshed.
observedIssues.decision: Refresh every Contract-declared checkpoint stage against the final Contract hash and rerun finish; do not treat the passing quality evidence as lifecycle completion.
observedIssues.resolution: Both before_edit and before_finish will be regenerated against Contract hash 79e3111ab867a0e5 before the final finish.
observedIssues.followUp: Final Agent Risk must pass with both checkpoint stages fresh.
